published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

verify.note: sim of the regenerated request, 180s, seed 1 (seed 1000003 within 1.1)

summary: Fire and Frost hybrid built on Frostfire Bolt, which gets both trees' talents.
rotation: The on-use trinket once Fire Vulnerability has 5 stacks. Other cooldowns on a free GCD. No mana gems, since they share Demonic Rune's cooldown.
Evocation below 10% mana with more than 75s left
Ice Lance on the last Fingers of Frost charge, ahead of Scorch and Pyroblast, for 3 times the damage and Shatter's crit. The first charge goes on a Frostfire Bolt.
Scorch to 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks and again with under 7s left
Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up stacks (1.5s cast)
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
Fire Blast on cooldown above 80% mana, or when mana is above 70 per second of fight left. Each one adds a Heating Up stack.
Rank 2 Frostfire Bolt when mana is under 30 per second of fight left, once Evocation is used or 75s or less are left
Ice Lance instead when a Frostfire Bolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 1.5s)
Wand when nothing else can be cast (out of mana)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Ice Lance's spell power coefficient is 0.429, the Season of Discovery value. The client has 0.
Every Fire Blast adds a Heating Up stack, or 2 on a crit. One Pyroblast uses them all.
Open: whether Fire Power's bonuses add or multiply. It counts Fire Vulnerability and up to 4 Fire DoTs. Frostfire Bolt gets it, but its DoT doesn't count as one.
Only the Manaflare 2-piece is active. The 4-piece and 5-piece aren't simulated.
Frost Channeling 3 adds nothing. It's only there to reach Fingers of Frost.
Frostfire Bolt's DoT has no spell power coefficient in the client.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Fireball stops at rank XI, Frostbolt at X and Arcane Missiles at VII. The books would add 50 DPS to Frost, 30 to Arcane, 17 to Fire and 0 to Frostfire.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_frostfire unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame) as a mage option, as the preset does. Its rotation casts Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge and Evocation below 30% mana with more than 60s left.
